notes: Substrate-ui is a browser reader UI over the substrate runtime's records. It also hosts an agent terminal that POSTs /api/agent and polls the resulting record. This vocabulary covers user-driven interaction (clicks, tab switches, chat turns) and per-pane render events. It does NOT try to model the substrate runtime itself — that runtime has its own record + vocabulary; substrate-ui reads them.

Every view-category tag inherits view_payload_universal fields (frame, visible, pane_id, subject_record). subject_record is the record name the pane is rendering, or null for panes that don't read from a record (rail, assay picker, terminal chrome).

The subject invariant: exactly one record is the active subject at a time (STATE.name in current app.ts). RECORD_SELECTED sets it; every view render tag after that carries the same subject_record until the next RECORD_SELECTED.

Poll cadence: the agent terminal polls /api/records/<name> at ~500 ms while a run is in flight. AGENT_TURN_STREAMED fires per poll cycle that observes new agent events; POLL_TIMEOUT is the incident-stratum companion if the poll fails.

The four view-toggle values (run, topo, structure, scene) are the current app.ts's graphView + a distinct 'structure' when the static topology view lands. Sprint 018 (TS conversion, 2026-08-14) has 'topology' as the tag; the run-as-graph vs structure split is per Architect's earlier terminal-v1 ruling and will resurface if terminal-v1 dispatches later.

tags.name: SESSION_INIT
tags.note: First signal on every page load. Anchors every subsequent signal's relative t.

tags.name: SESSION_ENDED
tags.note: Page unload (browser close, navigate away). Best-effort — beforeunload isn't guaranteed to fire.

tags.name: RECORDS_LOADED
tags.note: Rail fetch from /api/records completed. count is total; run_count + demo_count decompose it per the rail's grouping.

tags.name: RECORD_SELECTED
tags.note: User clicked a record in the rail (or a deep-link resolved). Sets STATE.name; every subsequent view render carries this as subject_record. prior_name is the previously-selected record or null.

tags.name: RECORDS_PRUNED
tags.note: User clicked the your-runs 'clear' affordance to delete session runs. Demos are preserved server-side.

tags.name: RECORD_LOAD_BEGIN
tags.note: selectRecord kicked off the per-record fetch chain (/api/records/<name>, /run_graph, /summary, /topology_graph).

tags.name: RECORD_LOADED
tags.note: All four projections landed. status is finalised | paused | incomplete | failed. Paired staleness guard: if a newer RECORD_LOAD_BEGIN fires first, this one is dropped.

tags.name: ASSAYS_LOADED
tags.note: Assay list fetched from /api/assays.

tags.name: ASSAY_SELECTED
tags.note: User clicked an assay in the rail.

tags.name: ASSAY_REPORT_LOADED
tags.note: Assay report fetched from /api/assay/<name> and rendered. verdict is the overall margin verdict when earned.

tags.name: VIEW_SWITCHED
tags.note: User toggled between run-as-graph, topology, structure, scene, or io. Payload subject_record is the current STATE.name.

tags.name: CURSOR_MOVED
tags.note: Replay cursor changed. source is drag | button | play_frame | keyboard.

tags.name: PLAY_STARTED
tags.note: Transport play began.

tags.name: PLAY_STOPPED
tags.note: Transport paused. reason is user_pause | end_reached | scrub_interrupt.

tags.name: SPEED_CHANGED
tags.note: Replay speed (frames/sec) changed.

tags.name: GRAPH_RENDERED
tags.note: Run-as-graph pane repainted. instance_count is the number of producer-instance lanes drawn at the current cursor.

tags.name: TOPOLOGY_RENDERED
tags.note: Static topology-structure pane repainted.

tags.name: SCENE_RENDERED
tags.note: Scene pane repainted (a domain-visual grid inferred from payload shape, e.g. game_of_life).

tags.name: IO_RENDERED
tags.note: I/O pane repainted. Shows seed/baseline as input and terminal-artifact events as outputs.

tags.name: HEALTH_RENDERED
tags.note: Health verdict repainted. verdict is FINALISED | FAILED | PAUSED | INCOMPLETE | LIVE.

tags.name: STREAM_RENDERED
tags.note: Event-stream pane repainted at the current cursor. line_count is rows visible.

tags.name: EVENT_INSPECTED
tags.note: User clicked an event in the stream; inspector shows its payload.

tags.name: PRODUCER_INSPECTED
tags.note: User clicked a producer lane in the graph; inspector shows the /explain/<instance> chain.

tags.name: TERMINAL_OPENED
tags.note: Terminal dock opened. trigger is toggle_button | ctrl_backtick | first_command.

tags.name: TERMINAL_CLOSED
tags.note: Dock collapsed.

tags.name: CHAT_ENTERED
tags.note: User typed 'chat' to enter conversation mode. reconnect=true when picking up an existing conversation.

tags.name: CHAT_EXITED
tags.note: User typed /exit. Conversation state is retained for reconnect.

tags.name: MODEL_SELECTED
tags.note: Model picker changed. model is an Ollama tag, a CLI preset name, or 'deterministic'.

tags.name: PARAMS_CHANGED
tags.note: User changed think | tokens | timeout. field is one of those three.

tags.name: TURN_SUBMITTED
tags.note: User Enter with a chat message. task_length is the character count of the transcript-augmented task string.

tags.name: AGENT_LAUNCH_REQUESTED
tags.note: POST /api/agent begun. params is {think, tokens, timeout}.

tags.name: AGENT_LAUNCHED
tags.note: POST /api/agent returned a run name; polling begins.

tags.name: AGENT_TURN_STREAMED
tags.note: A poll cycle observed new ToolCall/ToolResult/FinalAnswer events. new_events is the count added this cycle.

tags.name: FINAL_ANSWER_RENDERED
tags.note: FinalAnswer landed in termbody and (in chat mode) into STATE.term.chat.convo. Terminal turn is done.

tags.name: TOPOLOGY_LAUNCH_REQUESTED
tags.note: User clicked launch on a bundled topology name.

tags.name: TOPOLOGY_LAUNCHED
tags.note: POST /api/launch returned a run name; the new record is selected.

tags.name: RESUME_REQUESTED
tags.note: User clicked resume on a paused run.

tags.name: RESUMED
tags.note: POST /api/resume returned; the record's state advances.

tags.name: STUDIO_OPENED
tags.note: User navigated to /studio.html. via is header_link | direct_url.

tags.name: DIFF_REQUESTED
tags.note: User picked a diff target in the diff selector.

tags.name: DIFF_RENDERED
tags.note: Diff pane repainted with the first-divergence output from /api/diff.

tags.name: FETCH_FAILED
tags.note: An /api/* fetch failed. status_or_error is the HTTP status number or the caught exception message.

tags.name: LAUNCH_REJECTED
tags.note: A launch or resume POST returned an error field. kind is agent | topology | resume.

tags.name: POLL_TIMEOUT
tags.note: Agent-record poll exceeded its ceiling without a FinalAnswer or RunFinalised landing.

invariants: SESSION_INIT is the first signal in any capture.
SESSION_ENDED, when it fires, is the last signal.
RECORDS_LOADED fires before the first RECORD_SELECTED.
Every RECORD_SELECTED is followed within 5s by exactly one RECORD_LOADED with matching name (staleness guard drops earlier in-flight loads).
AGENT_LAUNCH_REQUESTED is followed within 1s by either AGENT_LAUNCHED or LAUNCH_REJECTED with kind=agent.
Every AGENT_LAUNCHED is followed by 1..N AGENT_TURN_STREAMED events and terminated by exactly one FINAL_ANSWER_RENDERED or POLL_TIMEOUT with the same run_name.
TURN_SUBMITTED only fires while CHAT_ENTERED is the current chat state (no CHAT_EXITED since).
View-category tags carry subject_record; if subject_record is non-null, it equals the STATE.name active at emit time.
rationale: 42 tags across 11 categories, stratified per grammar/PRINCIPLES.md commitment 5. Categories align with substrate-ui's actual subsystem boundaries as observed in web/app.ts (records rail, per-record fetch, assay board, view toggles, event stream, terminal dock, agent chat, topology launch, diff, incidents). view_payload_universal deviates from Katybird's frame/visible/scene_id/layer to frame/visible/pane_id/subject_record — 'scene_id' doesn't fit a reader UI's rendering model, and 'subject_record' is the load-bearing invariant carrier for the subject rule. Notes[] carries the four load-bearing conventions (subject invariant, poll cadence, view-toggle values, staleness guard). Invariants[] carries eight assertions the capture-grade harness enforces per sprint. This is v0.1; every gap identified during instrumentation surfaces as a supervised-grammar-evolution proposal (NEW_TAG_PROPOSED, PAYLOAD_FIELD_PROPOSED, etc.) and bumps to v0.2. Not yet locked — awaiting Architect ratification.
